t: You're looking at the former MacOwan Theatre, which was later converted to residential use, so it's no longer a stage. It was named after Michael MacOwan, a British actor who lived from 1906 to 1980. His name stayed on the building as a reminder of its theatrical past, even though the interior has changed. I don't have more detail on his career or when the theatre operated, so I won't guess. As a private residence now, it's best admired from the outside.
